Values specified in the Type could be returned.
V2X_GNTX_ACCEPTED if no error occurred.
V2X_GNTX_ACCEPTED transmit has been accepted
V2X_GNTX_E_MAXSDUSIZEOVFL transmit has been rejected due
to maximum length exceedance

unspecified reasons
